name: Nextcloud
about: Nextcloud is a powerful self-hosted alternative to Google Drive and Dropbox. It allows businesses to securely store, sync, and share files while maintaining full data ownership. Hosting Nextcloud on your VPS ensures complete privacy, better compliance, and predictable costs without per-user storage fees.
useCases: Ideal for businesses, remote teams, agencies, and organizations that need private cloud storage and collaboration tools.
performance: Runs on 4GB VPS for small teams. 8GB+ recommended for larger storage usage and concurrent users.
